digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, context-window sizing and model escalation
propositions: For a primary model absent from MODEL_LADDER, models_at_or_above() returns the entire ladder instead of the model itself, causing escalation to downgrade to smaller-window Anthropic rungs and cross provider families.

largest_window_tokens() returns MODEL_LADDER[-1][1] (1000000) for an unlocated primary instead of the ladder minimum (200000), overstating the context window and causing P8 to under-block material that will not fit.
prerequisites.py escalation at line 260-261 inherits the same defect via models_at_or_above(), jumping from nova to claude-haiku-4-5 without editing prerequisites.py itself.

The one-criterion retry in pass1_with_ladder must execute on the operator's configured model before emitting _too_big; returning an empty ladder would skip that retry and incorrectly proceed to failure.

For a truly unlocated primary with no profile-sourced window, the conservative default is the ladder minimum to avoid silent truncation; for an absent configured model (None), the ladder maximum is correct because the gate runs its own default.
